objective: Use only the strongest pre-match accumulator legs for a 100-cedi step-up campaign.
notes: Tradable set reflects the post-repair core that now has usable scored odds coverage and actual ticket usage in backtests.
Watchlist keeps stronger theoretical slices that are not yet practically tradable because odds coverage is missing or sparse.
Blocked set excludes draw-heavy or currently weak lines from the first accumulator campaign.
